title.narrative: Gendered experiences and Gen-Z civic and political choices

description.narrative: Gen Z choices, opinions and actions on major contemporary issues are not formed in a vacuum. They are the result of diverse factors relating to their experience of today’s world, their own identity, and the fabric of the communities within which they grow. Gendered expectations and experiences of Gen Z members can be among the primary factors motivating their civic and political behavior. Committed to understanding youth conditions to improve public policies, UNESCO will invest in exploring and analyzing the factors that affect Gen Z’s decisions and positioning in terms of their civic and political engagement. The purpose of the project would be to provide clarity and propose tangible policy orientations to prevent disruptive non-civic attitudes among youth (violence, hate speech and discrimination, extremist opinions, disinformation) and to further harness Gen Z’s constructive contribution to societies.
